stem: Per Rule 100102, in whom is the power to dismiss and exercise disciplinary control over officers in the Federal Civil Service vested?

options.B: The National Assembly
options.C: Each individual Permanent Secretary, without exception
options.D: The Head of the Civil Service of the Federation, personally and exclusively

options.B: A series of omissions or incompetence whose cumulative effect shows the officer cannot efficiently discharge their duties
options.C: Any instance of lateness to work, regardless of frequency
options.D: Refusal to accept a lawful transfer or posting

stem: Per Rule 100204, can a female public servant be required to resign or retire by reason of pregnancy alone?
